desc:
Every dummy is built from thousands of tiny voxels, so every hit breaks off exactly what it touched. No two smashes look the same!

🔨 85+ TOOLS: blasters, swords, axes, frying pans, golf clubs, rockets, freeze rays, portal guns and more
🧪 16 MUTATIONS: turn dummies into slime, crystal, robots, werewolves and more
🐂 ANIMALS: let the bull and the gorilla loose on the dummies
🚗 VEHICLES: crash cars into dummies
🌪️ EVENTS: meteors, tornadoes, black holes, wildfires and more
🗺️ 3 MAPS: Test Ground, Island and Building Site
🎯 7 CHALLENGES: from easy to hard, plus an endless survival mode
🩻 DOCTOR MODE: see the x-ray of every dummy

✅ Unlock new tools as you play
✅ Daily rewards, daily tests and a stunt book to fill
✅ Plays great on phone, PC, console and tablet

👍 Like and favorite for updates!
